# PackerOpsAI

> Two-Tier Green Cloud & Cluster Orchestrator for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving

PackerOpsAI is an enterprise Kubernetes orchestration system and cloud-native control plane designed to eliminate quiescent idle power dissipation (400W–750W per node) in accelerated AI datacenters (NVIDIA B200, H100, A100) during diurnal traffic valleys.

Founded on the scientific discoveries and patent portfolio of Dr. Oguzhan Sereflisan (Patent Application TR 2026/018692), PackerOpsAI co-optimizes physical server hardware power states and continuous token execution dynamics along the analytical GPU Roofline model.

## Core Architectural Components

- **Two-Tier Coupled MUBGA**: A multi-tiered heuristic genetic algorithm that co-optimizes host placement vector `h` (Tier-1 macro consolidation) and continuous batch regime vector `b` (Tier-2 micro Roofline pacing) in 15-minute decision windows.
- **Lemma 1 Break-Even Decision Engine**: Prevents migration thrashing across 400 Gbps RoCEv2 interconnects (45 J/GB energy toll) by enforcing the mathematical inequality: `Δt > t_break-even = E_mig / (P_quiescent - P_sleep)`.
- **Zero-Migration Stability Anchor**: Anchors prior epoch placements with 75% probability, eliminating 98.0% of diurnal model container thrashing (reducing network churn from 2,140 TB to 43 TB).
- **Automated ACPI S3 Hardware Sleep**: Out-of-band Node Lifecycle Controller via IPMI/Redfish that powers down empty nodes to <= 15W BMC standby with sub-second Wake-on-LAN recovery upon traffic surges.
- **Substation Power Headroom Expansion**: Dynamically caps peak surges, allowing datacenter operators to operate 25% more physical GPUs under identical electrical transformer capacity.

## Community Edition vs. Enterprise

- **Community Edition (Open Source, Apache 2.0)**:
  - Repository: https://github.com/packeropsai/packeropsai
  - Quiescent Leakage Audit CLI (`packerops-audit`): Quantifies kWh waste and financial leakage across idle Kubernetes GPU nodes.
  - Deterministic Best-Fit Decreasing (BFD) Kubernetes Scheduling Plugin.
  - 1-Command Kubectl install: `kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/packeropsai/packeropsai/main/deploy/manifests/install.yaml`
  - Helm 3+ Chart in `./deploy/helm/packerops-community`.

- **Enterprise Edition (Patent-Protected Core)**:
  - Full Coupled MUBGA Engine with Asymmetric Elitism (60/40) and Two-Tier Masked Crossover.
  - Real-time DCGM + Redfish Telemetry & Automated ACPI S3/P8 Sleep Orchestration.
  - Roofline Dynamic Continuous Token Batch Pacing (SGR-LS local search).
  - Substation Transformer Headroom Protection Dashboard.
  - Contact & Evaluation: https://packeropsai.com
